findings.detail: 'it' is allocated via the non-zeroing PyObject_GC_New() and freed with Py_DECREF(it) at line 2377 while it->parent_stack_used still hold allocator garbage — those members are written only *after* the free (or only on a branch that does not dominate it), and the file's destructor reads them while tearing down other members (see line 2178). tp_dealloc/tp_clear then acts on an uninitialized value (crash, dominant under OOM). Fix: NULL/initialize these members immediately after the allocation, before the first fallible call.
